sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Impostor Sort Puzzle are centered around the concept of distinguishing between the real and the fake. Players are presented with a series of puzzles, each consisting of a set of items or objects. The objective is to sort the items into two categories: real and fake. Sounds simple, right? However, things get complicated quickly as the items are often presented in a cluttered and confusing manner, making it challenging for players to identify the impostors.

         To play, players use their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to drag and drop items into the corresponding categories. The game features a variety of items, each with its unique characteristics, making it essential to pay close attention to details. As players progress through the levels, the puzzles become increasingly difficult, requiring players to use their critical thinking and logical reasoning skills to succeed.

         One of the standout features of Impostor Sort Puzzle is its ability to adapt to the player's skill level. The game's AI is cleverly designed to adjust the difficulty level based on the player's performance, ensuring that the puzzles remain challenging yet manageable. This feature makes the game an ideal choice for players of all ages and skill levels, as it caters to different players' needs and preferences.
